title: Form CP502 (amendment of instalment payment) for YA 2027 now available
publication_date: Not stated (form revision CP502 [Rev.3/2026]; first seen on HASiL Download Forms 23/11/2026)
summary: HASiL has published Form CP502 [Rev.3/2026], used by individuals who disagree with their Notice of Instalment Payment (CP500) to apply under s.107B(2) ITA 1967 to amend their tax instalments, for YA 2027. Its schedule sets the six instalments from 01/03/2027 to 01/01/2028. The YA 2026 version (CP502 [Rev.2/2026]) is still listed.
